Announcement #3

Created: 2026-09-09T05:06:00Z

:large_green_circle: Monad Foundation raising delegated stake through the VDP.:large_green_circle:

Monad Foundation will soon increase the amount of MON delegated through the Validator Delegation Program (VDP) by approximately 5 billion MON.

This increase is consistent with the previously communicated plan to delegate between 15 billion and 25 billion MON through the VDP during the first year of Monad Mainnet.

As part of this increase, the amount of MON delegated to validators in each VDP tier will increase as follows:
Tier    Current Delegation.    New Delegation
T1       90m MON                   140m MON
T2       75m MON                   110m MON
T3       52.5m MON                75m MON
T4       25m MON                    35m MON

This change does not affect validators' current tier classifications.

The maximum commission rate for validators participating in the VDP remains 15%.

Many thanks,
Monad Foundation
